name: Vanthorpe Meridian Conceal Shoulder Rig
description:
Over-jacket shoulder harness in black vegetable-tanned synthetic leather, cut narrow and flat to disappear under a blazer or coat. Main holster sits high under the left arm with a magnetic retention snap; a counterweight pouch on the right holds spare charge packs or a secondary piece. All hardware is matte black — no shine, no jangle.

Straps cross at the upper back via a low-profile X-brace that accommodates spinal rig hardware through a split-rail channel. The whole rig weighs 340 grams unloaded. Favored by Tier 4 specialists who need to carry without advertising it.
functionality: Magnetic snap retention allows one-handed draw. Counterweight pouch balances the load and accepts secondary weapon or charge packs. Split-rail back channel routes cleanly over spinal augmentation rigs. Strap tension is micro-adjustable for chrome arm fittings. Sits flat enough to remain undetectable under a structured jacket.
what_it_says: This person is armed, doesn't want you to know it, and has enough resources to do it elegantly.
worn_by: junior executives in hostile negotiation roles
story_hooks: A counterweight pouch is found to contain a chip with encrypted comms — not weapons-related at all, suggesting the rig is being used as a dead drop carrier.
Vanthorpe's latest batch has a manufacturing defect in the magnetic snap that causes it to partially disengage under strong electromagnetic fields — common near MagRail stations.
A character is given this rig by a contact who says it belonged to someone who 'won't be needing it' — the previous owner's biometric trace is still warm in the microfiber lining.
related_entities: Ringo Heavy Transit MagRail Levitation Transport Network

physical_description.visual_profile: A lean, minimalist shoulder harness designed to vanish beneath formal wear. The rig creates a subtle vertical line down the torso when worn under a blazer, with no visible bulge or protrusion. The aesthetic is utilitarian-professional: all business, zero flash.
physical_description.fit: Compression-style with narrow straps that sit flush against the shoulders and ribs. The X-brace at the upper back distributes weight evenly and accommodates spinal augmentations without binding. Adjustable via hidden friction tabs along the lateral straps.
physical_description.primary_material: Black vegetable-tanned synthetic leather—durable, matte, and specifically chosen for its sound-dampening properties and lack of reflective sheen.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, aged leather surface with a subtle grain; straps show a faint crosshatch weave. Hardware sits recessed into the material to prevent snagging or catching.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black throughout—leather, straps, stitching, and all hardware. Zero contrast or accent colors; design prioritizes concealment over aesthetics.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic retention snap on the main holster; friction-fit adjustment tabs along back straps; no zippers or obvious fasteners visible from the front.
distinctive_features: Low-profile X-brace with split-rail channel for spinal rig compatibility
High-set holster positioned directly under left armpit for quick access and invisible carry
Right-side counterweight pouch sized for charge packs or secondary sidearm
Matte black hardware with zero shine—designed to avoid detection by optical or thermal scanning
Minimal stitching; seams are flat-felled to reduce profile and noise
Vanthorpe branding is small, embossed on an interior reinforcement tab only
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4 functional—this is working-class professional gear, not a status piece. A Tier 2 corpo would wear something shinier; a Tier 5 scav would carry openly.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by mid-tier security specialists, off-duty corps enforcement, private investigators, and field operatives who need reliable concealment without the flash of black-market gear. It signals competence, discipline, and access to vetted equipment.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and lived-in. The leather shows faint scuff marks from regular carry and adjustment; the magnetic snap has a barely visible wear ring. The rig is maintained obsessively but looks used, never pristine.
